## Schema.applyDefaults() method

Applies default values to the given document according to the schema definition.

**Signature:**

```typescript
applyDefaults(value: unknown, options: SchemaMethodOptions): any;
```

**Returns:**

any

Returns the document with default values applied

## Remarks

This method is called internally by the top level model when creating a new document. Normally, there is no need to call it manually, unless you want to apply defaults to a document before creating an instance of the model.
